sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Gigadrone was used alongside Venomaster by Unnamed Suit 053, from The Organization now led by Mr. Wilder to ambush and destroy the Huntik team. It fought Dante Vale and his Caliban but was defeated by Lok's Raijin the Thunderbolt. Three more Gigadrone Titans were later used by Mr. Wilder's Suits outside the waterfall cave in an attempt to stop Dante Vale and Zhalia Moon. After fighting Gar-Ghoul and Elf King Oberon, the final Gigadrone was defeated by the newly Powerbonded Baselaird's 'Sword Strike' ability. [Doorway to Huntik]

Two Gigadrones were used by Mr. Wilder's Suits outside the Crystal Caves to ambush the Huntik team and destroy their tents. One pursued Lok and Cherit and chased them through the woods. Despite catching up, Gigadrone was defeated by Powerbonded Kipperin's 'Light Burst' ability. Two more were later seen accompanying the Organization boats to Avalon. [Knight of the Willblade]

Gigadrone was summoned by Unnamed Suit 055 to fight alongside Venomaster against Dante's Metagolem but was defeated by Lane's Wildwood Druid when Lucas Casterwill and his team intervened. [Chasing Void]

Gigadrone was summoned personally by Mr. Wilder to fight Zhalia's Januseea the Gatekeeper. It fought and defeated Januseea but was defeated by Lok's Powerbonded Baselaird. [The Blood Spiral]

Mr. Wilder attempted to summon Gigadrone against Powerbonded Breaker but he was stopped by Grier. [An Ally from the Organization]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext: Gigadrone is able to fly quickly and nimbly, adept at maneuvering through tight spaces such as forests where trees would block a larger Titan's movements whilst his appendages allow him to move at great pace over terrain. {{source|Knight of the Willblade}} Gigadrone's key strength of attack lies in his ability to fire energy blasts from its eyes, powerful enough to defeat a Titan like [[Januseea the Gatekeeper|Januseea]] {{source|The Blood Spiral}} and disorientate larger enemies such as [[Metagolem]] while staying out of reach. {{source|Chasing Void}} It is also quite strong, and has good eyesight.

full_text:
Gigadrone is a flying, insectoid Swara-Titan with six appendages, four of which serve as arms. Able to fire laser blasts from his eyes, this Titan is commonly used alongside Venomaster by Mr. Wilder's Suits, serving a similar purpose to the Mindrone and Enforcer Titans by specializing in ranged aerial attacks.

==History==
Gigadrone was used alongside Venomaster by Unnamed Suit 053, from The Organization now led by Mr. Wilder to ambush and destroy the Huntik team. It fought Dante Vale and his Caliban but was defeated by Lok's Raijin the Thunderbolt. Three more Gigadrone Titans were later used by Mr. Wilder's Suits outside the waterfall cave in an attempt to stop Dante Vale and Zhalia Moon. After fighting Gar-Ghoul and Elf King Oberon, the final Gigadrone was defeated by the newly Powerbonded Baselaird's 'Sword Strike' ability. [Doorway to Huntik]

Two Gigadrones were used by Mr. Wilder's Suits outside the Crystal Caves to ambush the Huntik team and destroy their tents. One pursued Lok and Cherit and chased them through the woods. Despite catching up, Gigadrone was defeated by Powerbonded Kipperin's 'Light Burst' ability. Two more were later seen accompanying the Organization boats to Avalon. [Knight of the Willblade]

Gigadrone was summoned by Unnamed Suit 055 to fight alongside Venomaster against Dante's Metagolem but was defeated by Lane's Wildwood Druid when Lucas Casterwill and his team intervened. [Chasing Void]

Gigadrone was summoned personally by Mr. Wilder to fight Zhalia's Januseea the Gatekeeper. It fought and defeated Januseea but was defeated by Lok's Powerbonded Baselaird. [The Blood Spiral]

Mr. Wilder attempted to summon Gigadrone against Powerbonded Breaker but he was stopped by Grier. [An Ally from the Organization]

==Abilities==
Gigadrone is able to fly quickly and nimbly, adept at maneuvering through tight spaces such as forests where trees would block a larger Titan's movements whilst his appendages allow him to move at great pace over terrain. [Knight of the Willblade] Gigadrone's key strength of attack lies in his ability to fire energy blasts from its eyes, powerful enough to defeat a Titan like Januseea [The Blood Spiral] and disorientate larger enemies such as Metagolem while staying out of reach. [Chasing Void] It is also quite strong, and has good eyesight.
